settings.title: Order now, pay over time.
settings.text:
What is Afterpay?

Afterpay allows you to purchase your gifts and decor today, and pay it off in four equal payments. Using Afterpay you can pay for your Alley Cat Trading order fortnightly. It's quick and easy to set up, you simply click the 'Afterpay' option during checkout. Payment will be automatically taken from your debit or credit card in four equal payments every 14 days, but you will be able to order immediately! This applies to the entire Alley Cat Trading product range. Afterpay it today!

How to Use Afterpay?

  • Spend up to $1000 on the Alley Cat Trading website.
  • Add your items to the shopping cart.
  • Select Afterpay as your payment method.
  • Checkout as normal.
  • Enter your details with Afterpay.
  • Your order will be shipped....and you are done to enjoy your purchase!

For all the information on buying with Afterpay please visit www.afterpay.com.au
For Afterpay’s complete terms, please visit www.afterpay.com.au/terms
